summary: Tested BackgroundPicker Image tab in Edit Note > Tile Accent (Choose background). Curated gallery is visible with 10 images in a 4-column grid and Upload button is present. However, clicking a curated image CRASHES the app with 'ReferenceError: onChange is not defined' — the handler at BackgroundPicker.jsx line 535 calls onChange() but the component prop is onSelect. Selection flow is broken.
passed: Edit Note modal opens via accordion edit button
Choose background opens Tile background dialog with Color/Gradient/Image tabs
Image tab renders Upload button + 'Curated backgrounds' section heading
10 curated images render in a 4-column grid with data-testid bg-curated-image-0..9

failed.area: BackgroundPicker Image tab - curated image click
failed.issue: Clicking a curated image throws ReferenceError: onChange is not defined. The onClick handler calls onChange({type:'image', value:imgUrl}) but the component prop is named onSelect (see other handlers in file). Red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay appears, selection does not apply.
failed.evidence: Playwright click on [data-testid=bg-curated-image-0] triggered error overlay: 'onChange is not defined ReferenceError: onChange is not defined at onClick (bundle.js:284424:19)'. File reference: /app/frontend/src/components/BackgroundPicker.jsx line 535.

failed.area: Curated image count vs user request
failed.issue: User reported missing gallery of 205 images; implementation only adds 10 curated images. Main agent should confirm with user whether this matches expectation.
failed.evidence: CURATED_IMAGES array in BackgroundPicker.jsx lines 14-25 contains 10 URLs.

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/components/BackgroundPicker.jsx line 535: replace onChange({type:'image', value:imgUrl}) with onSelect({type:'image', value:imgUrl}) (same pattern used by color/gradient handlers in this file).
Confirm with user whether 10 curated images is acceptable or if the original 205-image gallery needs to be restored.
After fix, retest: click bg-curated-image-0 should apply background, show success toast, and not crash.
